name: sdlc
description: Artifact-driven SDLC (intent → spec → plan → build → cross-agent review) with deterministic guards, git hooks and a CI gate. Shared with Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: intent → spec → plan → build → cross-agent review, with guards
interface.longDescription: Runs an artifact-driven SDLC: every change is captured as intent.md, spec.md and plan.md under docs/changes/, implemented against an approved plan, verified with one command and reviewed by the other agent (Codex ↔ Claude Code). Deterministic guards run as hooks, git hooks and a CI gate.
